description: Web and mobile application security training platform.

license.redistribution: A future project build must satisfy GPL source and corresponding-source obligations; none is authorized yet.

limitations: Provenance, containment, licensing, architecture, or functionality review is incomplete.
trust.status_reason: No official remote OCI artifact exists; upstream deployment builds generated WAR, database, and Mongo images from mutable bases.

checks: Challenge catalogue and per-user state usable

reset.strategy: Remove only owned MariaDB, MongoDB, Tomcat configuration, and log volumes

default_credentials: admin / password (mandatory change after first login)

outbound_network.reason: Core web lessons have no documented Internet requirement.
challenge_dependencies: Mobile challenges require Android artifacts, a device or emulator, and ADB

expected_functionality: CTF, tournament, progress, scoreboard, and administration modes
known_limitations: Mobile training is outside a web-container-only deployment
